name: Gremlins
description: The Gremlins were a teenage street gang based in the Park Slope neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York, active during the 1950s. They were rivals of a nearby gang called the Ditmas Dukes. In 1958, member Robert Fasano, known as "Buffalo Bob," shot and killed Louis Cuomo, a member of the Ditmas Dukes. Fasano and fellow member Salvatore Monaco were subsequently convicted of murder.
